_comment: Databricks Workflow — Customer CDC Pipeline (runs every 4 hours)
Original trigger: AutoSys job JOB_CUSTOMER_CDC (every 4 hours)
Ab Initio pipeline steps mapped to Databricks tasks:
Step 1: air sandbox run snapshot_customer.mp      → task: snapshot_customer
Step 2: air sandbox run cdc_detect_customer.mp     → task: cdc_detect (Delta MERGE)
Step 3: air sandbox run apply_customer_changes.mp  → (merged into cdc_detect — MERGE is atomic)
Step 4: air sandbox run audit_customer_changes.mp  → task: audit_changes
PSET parameters (from customer_cdc.pset) mapped to job parameters:
name: customer_cdc_pipeline
description: Customer CDC pipeline — snapshot, detect changes, apply, audit. Runs every 4 hours. Migrated from Ab Initio KornShell orchestration (run_customer_cdc.ksh).

schedule._comment: Every 4 hours — matches original AutoSys JOB_CUSTOMER_CDC schedule

parameters.name: source_path
parameters._comment: Maps to Ab Initio PSET: SOURCE_PATH=/data/raw/customer

parameters.name: target_table
parameters._comment: Maps to Ab Initio PSET: TARGET_TABLE=STAGING.CUSTOMER_MASTER

parameters.name: key_columns
parameters._comment: Maps to Ab Initio PSET: KEY_COLUMNS=customer_id

parameters.name: partition_count
parameters._comment: Maps to Ab Initio PSET: PARTITION_COUNT=8 (matches -partition 8 flag)

parameters.name: audit_table
parameters._comment: Maps to Ab Initio PSET: AUDIT_TABLE=AUDIT.CUSTOMER_CHANGES

parameters.name: max_errors
parameters._comment: Maps to Ab Initio PSET: MAX_ERRORS=50

parameters.name: retention_days
parameters._comment: Maps to Ab Initio PSET: RETENTION_DAYS=90

tasks.description: Step 1: Snapshot current state from source. Replaces: air sandbox run snapshot_customer.mp
Steps 2+3: CDC detect AND apply via Delta MERGE (atomic). Replaces: cdc_detect_customer.mp + apply_customer_changes.mp
Step 4: Generate audit trail. Replaces: air sandbox run audit_customer_changes.mp

query.query_string: INSERT INTO {{job.parameters.audit_table}}_summary SELECT '{{job.parameters.target_table}}' AS target_table, current_timestamp() AS audit_timestamp, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_changes('{{job.parameters.target_table}}', (SELECT MAX(version) FROM (DESCRIBE HISTORY {{job.parameters.target_table}} LIMIT 2))) WHERE _change_type = 'insert') AS inserts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_changes('{{job.parameters.target_table}}', (SELECT MAX(version) FROM (DESCRIBE HISTORY {{job.parameters.target_table}} LIMIT 2))) WHERE _change_type = 'update_postimage') AS updates, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_changes('{{job.parameters.target_table}}', (SELECT MAX(version) FROM (DESCRIBE HISTORY {{job.parameters.target_table}} LIMIT 2))) WHERE _change_type = 'delete') AS deletes

tasks.description: Housekeeping: Remove snapshots older than retention window. Replaces manual archive rotation.

on_failure._comment: Replaces Ab Initio Slack webhook alerts from job_monitor.py
